fish.name: Silver Bream
fish.desc: A flat, shimmering river fish. Loves slow bends.
fish.descID: Ikan sungai pipih yang berkilau. Suka tikungan yang tenang.
fish.hint: Anywhere on the river, any time.
fish.hintID: Di mana saja di sungai, kapan saja.
fish.art: deep-bodied flat silver bream fish with shimmering pale silver scales and soft coral-red fins

fish.name: Brook Trout
fish.desc: Speckled and quick. Bites best in the cool morning.
fish.descID: Berbintik dan gesit. Paling sering makan umpan di pagi yang sejuk.
fish.art: brook trout with an olive-green back, cream worm-like speckles, red spots with blue halos, an orange belly and orange lower fins with white edges

fish.name: Perch
fish.desc: Striped ambusher that hides in the shade of the dock.
fish.descID: Pemburu bergaris yang bersembunyi di bayangan dermaga.
fish.hint: Near the dock, during the day.
fish.art: European perch with a golden-yellow green body, bold dark vertical bars, a spiny dorsal fin and bright orange-red lower fins

fish.name: Roach
fish.desc: A small silvery shoaler with ruby-red eyes.
fish.descID: Ikan kecil keperakan yang bergerombol, matanya merah delima.
fish.art: small silvery roach fish with a blue-grey back, bright red eyes and reddish-orange fins

fish.name: Gudgeon
fish.desc: A little bottom-dweller with whiskers and spotted fins.
fish.descID: Ikan dasar kecil berkumis dengan sirip berbintik.
fish.art: small slender gudgeon fish with a sandy-brown body, a row of dark blotches along its side, tiny barbels and spotted fins

fish.name: Dace
fish.desc: A slim, fast silver dart of the current.
fish.descID: Ikan ramping keperakan yang melesat di arus.
fish.art: slim streamlined dace fish, bright silver body with an olive back and pale yellowish fins

fish.name: Pike
fish.desc: A long green hunter. Comes out as the day cools.
fish.descID: Pemburu panjang berwarna hijau. Keluar saat hari mulai sejuk.
fish.hint: River and dock, in the evening.
fish.art: long slender northern pike with a green body covered in pale cream bean-shaped spots and a long flat duck-bill snout

fish.name: Barbel
fish.desc: A powerful bronze bottom-feeder with four whiskers.
fish.descID: Ikan dasar perunggu yang kuat dengan empat kumis.
fish.hint: Deep river runs, dusk to dawn.
fish.hintID: Arus sungai dalam, senja hingga fajar.
fish.art: barbel fish with a long bronze-gold body, a downturned mouth with four fleshy whiskers and reddish fins

fish.name: Rudd
fish.desc: A golden fish with blood-red fins that sips from the surface.
fish.descID: Ikan keemasan bersirip merah darah yang menyeruput permukaan.
fish.art: rudd fish with a deep golden-bronze body, an upturned mouth and vivid blood-red fins

fish.name: Zander
fish.desc: Glassy-eyed night stalker with fangs like needles.
fish.descID: Pemburu malam bermata kaca dengan taring setajam jarum.
fish.art: zander fish with a grey-green body, faint dark bands, large glassy eyes, two dorsal fins and sharp teeth

fish.name: Golden Carp
fish.desc: Glows like a coin under the noon waterfall. Grandpa called it 'the Golden one'.
fish.descID: Bersinar seperti koin di bawah air terjun siang hari. Kakek menyebutnya 'Si Emas'.
fish.hintID: Kolam Air Terjun, sekitar tengah hari.
fish.art: plump legendary golden carp with large shiny gold scales, a rounded back, small soft barbels by its mouth and flowing golden fins, majestic

fish.name: Moon Eel
fish.desc: Only seen at night, trailing faint blue light. The last page of Grandpa's journal.
fish.descID: Hanya terlihat di malam hari, meninggalkan cahaya biru samar. Halaman terakhir jurnal kakek.
fish.hint: Riverlight at night — the final legend.
fish.hintID: Riverlight di malam hari — legenda terakhir.
fish.art: slender dark indigo moon eel with faint glowing pale-blue spots along its body and a long soft ribbon fin, mystical

fish.name: Bluegill
fish.desc: A round, friendly sunfish with a blue cheek.
fish.descID: Ikan matahari bulat yang ramah dengan pipi biru.
fish.art: round bluegill sunfish with an olive body, faint vertical bars, an orange breast and a dark blue gill flap

fish.name: Crappie
fish.desc: Speckled like a starry night, schools around sunken branches.
fish.descID: Berbintik seperti malam berbintang, bergerombol di dahan tenggelam.
fish.art: black crappie fish with a silvery body covered in dark mottled speckles and large spotted fins

fish.name: Yellow Perch
fish.desc: Bright yellow with seven dark saddles.
fish.descID: Kuning cerah dengan tujuh pelana gelap.
fish.hint: Near the dock, during the day.
fish.art: yellow perch fish with a bright yellow body, six dark vertical saddle bars and orange lower fins

fish.name: Tench
fish.desc: The 'doctor fish' — slippery, olive and calm, with red eyes.
fish.descID: 'Ikan dokter' — licin, hijau zaitun dan tenang, bermata merah.
fish.art: tench fish with a thick olive-green slimy body, tiny scales, small red eyes and rounded dark fins

fish.name: Rainbow Trout
fish.desc: A pink stripe runs down its side like a rainbow.
fish.descID: Garis merah muda membentang di sisinya seperti pelangi.
fish.art: rainbow trout with a silvery body, an iridescent pink lateral stripe, a green back and many small black spots

fish.name: Golden Shiner
fish.desc: A little gold flash among the stems.
fish.descID: Kilatan emas kecil di antara batang ilalang.
fish.art: small golden shiner minnow with a gleaming gold-brass body, a curved lateral line and pale fins

fish.name: Largemouth Bass
fish.desc: Big mouth, big appetite — explodes from the weeds.
fish.descID: Mulut besar, nafsu makan besar — melesat dari rerumputan.
fish.art: largemouth bass with a green body, a dark jagged horizontal stripe, a white belly and a very large mouth

fish.name: Channel Catfish
fish.desc: Whiskered and patient, it hunts by taste in the dark.
fish.descID: Berkumis dan sabar, berburu lewat rasa dalam gelap.
fish.art: channel catfish with a smooth blue-grey body, a forked tail, small dark spots and long whiskers around its mouth

fish.name: Pumpkinseed
fish.desc: Painted in orange and turquoise squiggles.
fish.descID: Dihiasi coretan oranye dan pirus.
fish.art: pumpkinseed sunfish with an orange-speckled body, turquoise wavy lines on its cheek and a red-tipped ear flap

fish.name: Muskellunge
fish.desc: The 'fish of ten thousand casts'.
fish.descID: 'Ikan sepuluh ribu lemparan'.
fish.art: huge muskellunge fish with a long silvery-green body, dark tiger-stripe bars and a long toothy snout

fish.name: Paddlefish
fish.desc: An ancient fish with a nose shaped like a canoe paddle.
fish.descID: Ikan purba dengan moncong berbentuk dayung kano.
fish.art: ancient paddlefish with a smooth blue-grey shark-like body and a very long flat paddle-shaped snout

fish.name: Lantern Koi
fish.desc: A white-and-scarlet koi that glows like a paper lantern. Grandma released it on the night of the festival.
fish.descID: Koi putih-merah yang bercahaya seperti lentera kertas. Nenek melepaskannya di malam festival.
fish.art: legendary glowing koi fish, pearl-white body with scarlet and gold patches, long flowing veil fins that glow softly like a paper lantern, magical

fish.name: Grayling
fish.desc: Wears a sail-like dorsal fin painted purple and red.
fish.descID: Bersirip punggung seperti layar berwarna ungu dan merah.
fish.art: grayling fish with a silver-violet body, scattered black spots and a huge sail-like dorsal fin edged in red and purple

fish.name: Brown Trout
fish.desc: Golden-brown with red and black spots ringed in pale halos.
fish.descID: Cokelat keemasan dengan bintik merah dan hitam berlingkar.
fish.art: brown trout with a golden-brown body covered in black and red spots surrounded by pale halos

fish.name: Arctic Char
fish.desc: A cold-water jewel with a sunset-orange belly.
fish.descID: Permata air dingin dengan perut jingga senja.
fish.art: arctic char fish with a dark olive back, pale pink spots and a vivid sunset-orange belly with white-edged fins

fish.name: Sculpin
fish.desc: A big-headed pebble-coloured fish that hides under stones.
fish.descID: Ikan berkepala besar warna kerikil yang bersembunyi di bawah batu.
fish.art: sculpin fish with a big flat head, wide pectoral fins and a mottled brown-grey pebble pattern

fish.name: Chub
fish.desc: A bold, big-mouthed fish that eats almost anything.
fish.descID: Ikan berani bermulut besar yang memakan hampir apa saja.
fish.art: chub fish with a thick bronze-silver body, large dark-edged scales, a broad head and orange-red lower fins

fish.name: Stone Loach
fish.desc: A tiny whiskered fish striped like river stones.
fish.descID: Ikan kecil berkumis bercorak seperti batu sungai.
fish.art: small stone loach fish, slender with a marbled yellow-brown pattern and six tiny whiskers

fish.name: Steelhead
fish.desc: A sea-run rainbow, gleaming steel-blue, that leaps waterfalls.
fish.descID: Pelangi yang pergi ke laut, biru baja berkilau, melompati air terjun.
fish.art: steelhead trout with a gleaming steel-blue silver body, a faint pink stripe and small black spots

fish.name: Cutthroat Trout
fish.desc: Named for the scarlet slash under its jaw.
fish.descID: Dinamai dari garis merah di bawah rahangnya.
fish.art: cutthroat trout with a golden-olive body, heavy black spots and a bright red slash under the jaw

fish.name: Lake Trout
fish.desc: Grey and cream-spotted giant of cold deep water.
fish.descID: Raksasa abu-abu berbintik krem dari air dalam yang dingin.
fish.art: lake trout with a dark grey-green body covered in irregular cream spots and a deeply forked tail

fish.name: Taimen
fish.desc: The 'river wolf' — a giant red-tailed salmon of the gorge.
fish.descID: 'Serigala sungai' — salmon raksasa berekor merah dari ngarai.
fish.art: huge taimen salmon with a copper-red tail and fins, a long olive body peppered with small black crosses

fish.name: Golden Trout
fish.desc: A tiny miracle of gold, red and olive found only in high pools.
fish.descID: Keajaiban kecil berwarna emas, merah dan zaitun di kolam tinggi.
fish.art: golden trout with a bright gold body, a crimson stripe along the side, olive parr marks and white-tipped fins

fish.name: Ironscale Sturgeon
fish.desc: Armoured in bony plates, older than the pines. It broke Grandpa's line on the night of the great storm.
fish.descID: Berlapis sisik tulang, lebih tua dari pohon pinus. Ia memutus tali kakek di malam badai besar.
fish.hint: The deepest pool of Pinefall Gorge.
fish.art: legendary ancient sturgeon with an iron-grey armoured body, rows of bony diamond plates along its back, a pointed snout and four whiskers, majestic

fish.name: Grey Mullet
fish.desc: Grey-striped grazer that cruises the tidal flats.
fish.descID: Ikan bergaris abu-abu yang merumput di dataran pasang surut.
fish.art: grey mullet fish with a torpedo-shaped silver-grey body, dark horizontal stripes and a blunt head

fish.name: Flounder
fish.desc: Lies flat in the sand with both eyes on one side.
fish.descID: Berbaring pipih di pasir dengan kedua mata di satu sisi.
fish.art: flounder flatfish, oval and flat, sandy-brown with orange speckles, both eyes on the top side

fish.name: Mackerel
fish.desc: Zebra-striped racer of the open sea.
fish.descID: Pelari laut lepas bercorak zebra.
fish.art: atlantic mackerel with a sleek body, iridescent blue-green back with black wavy tiger stripes and a silver belly

fish.name: Gilt-head Bream
fish.desc: A golden band glints between its eyes.
fish.descID: Pita emas berkilau di antara kedua matanya.
fish.art: gilt-head bream fish, oval silver-grey body with a golden band between the eyes and a dark spot at the gill

fish.name: Sand Smelt
fish.desc: A see-through little fish with a silver racing stripe.
fish.descID: Ikan kecil tembus pandang dengan garis perak.
fish.art: small translucent sand smelt fish with a bright silver lateral stripe and a pale greenish back

fish.name: Pufferfish
fish.desc: Puffs into a spiky ball when it's surprised. Handle with care!
fish.descID: Menggembung jadi bola berduri saat terkejut. Hati-hati!
fish.art: round spotted pufferfish, yellow-cream body with brown spots and small spikes, big cute eyes

fish.name: Sea Bass
fish.desc: A silver wolf of the surf that hunts at dusk.
fish.descID: Serigala perak di ombak yang berburu saat senja.
fish.hintID: Laut dan air dalam, petang hari.
fish.art: european sea bass with a sleek silver body, a dark grey back, spiny dorsal fin and a black spot on the gill cover

fish.name: Red Snapper
fish.desc: Rose-red and red-eyed, from the rocky deep.
fish.descID: Merah mawar bermata merah, dari kedalaman berbatu.
fish.art: red snapper fish with a rose-red body, a pinkish belly, red eyes and a sloped forehead

fish.name: Barracuda
fish.desc: A silver arrow with a smile full of fangs.
fish.descID: Anak panah perak dengan senyum penuh taring.
fish.art: great barracuda with a long silver torpedo body, dark diagonal bars, scattered black spots and a toothy underbite

fish.name: Silver Tarpon
fish.desc: The 'silver king' that leaps clean out of the water.
fish.descID: 'Raja perak' yang melompat tinggi dari air.
fish.art: silver tarpon with huge mirror-like silver scales, a dark blue back, an upturned mouth and a long trailing dorsal ray

fish.name: Moonfish
fish.desc: A round, rosy fish of the deep, dotted like a starry sky.
fish.descID: Ikan bundar kemerahan dari kedalaman, berbintik seperti langit malam.
fish.art: opah moonfish, very round tall body, rosy-red with white polka dots and bright crimson fins

fish.name: Old King Grouper
fish.desc: Wise and enormous, it has guarded the lighthouse rocks for a hundred years. Grandpa called it 'the King'.
fish.descID: Bijak dan raksasa, menjaga batu mercusuar selama seratus tahun. Kakek menyebutnya 'Sang Raja'.
fish.hint: Below the lighthouse, in the evening.
fish.art: legendary giant grouper fish, massive mottled brown-gold body with dark marbled patches, huge mouth and wise old eyes, regal
